title: Panthers GM Dan Morgan: Looking forward to Monroe Freeling/Rasheed Walker left tackle competition

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Panthers GM Dan Morgan: Looking forward to Monroe Freeling/Rasheed Walker left tackle competition
sources.description: The Panthers went into the offseason knowing that left tackle Ikem Ekwonu is unlikely to be available for some time as he recovers from a torn patellar tendon and they addressed that reality multiple times.
